remarks: Your own poolside retreat in the desirable Wild Rose Ranch community! This four-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath home offers approximately 1,743 square feet of living space and an inviting backyard made for enjoying Southern California living. Separate living and den spaces provide room to gather, entertain, or unwind, while a fireplace adds warmth to the den. A downstairs bedroom offers flexibility for guests or a home office, with a half bath conveniently located on the main level. A walk-in closet, dedicated laundry room, central air conditioning, and attached two-car garage add everyday comfort and convenience. Outside, the private swimming pool takes center stage, surrounded by mature land
